title: SpaceDeployActivatedPayload
description: space.deploy.activated v1 (OpenVibe.Space server/domain/deploys.js switchPointer, Stage B tenant hosting). A tenant site's active deploy changed, written into Host's event outbox in the transaction that moves the pointer (activate or rollback). Envelope: subject { type: deploy, id: <deploy id> }, visibility internal, priority low, actor the person or app that switched it. A network service's release going live is space.release.published, not this.

previous_deploy_id.description: The deploy that served before; null for the site's first activation.

rollback.description: true when the switch was a rollback.
